name: Codebase Memory MCP
description: Install the codebase-memory-mcp binary and configure it for detected coding agents.

version.description: Enter a codebase-memory-mcp version (e.g. 'v0.9.0'), or use 'latest'.

autoIndex.description: Enable the binary's own auto-indexing of new projects on first MCP session connection (codebase-memory-mcp config set auto_index).

ui.description: Install the UI variant, which adds an optional 3D graph-visualization web UI.
